name: SME bookkeeping
summary: How foreign founders set up SME bookkeeping in Singapore — cloud ledgers, GST registration cues, IRAS filing support, and what bookkeepers do not replace in tax advice.
body:
Bookkeepers keep bank feeds, invoices, payroll exports, and GST worksheets clean. They are not automatically tax agents — confirm who signs IRAS submissions and who advises on XP / foreign income.

## Scope to define
- Monthly management accounts vs annual cleanup
- GST registration threshold monitoring
- Payroll / CPF file handoff to a separate provider
- Xero / QuickBooks / SQL admin ownership
- Year-end package for tax agent

Founders still own CorpPass roles and bank authority.

## How to choose
Prefer firms that document turnaround SLAs and software seats. Ask who reviews GST coding. Confirm exit handoff if you leave Singapore mid-year.

## Practical tip
Reconcile the corporate card weekly yourself for the first month. Bookkeepers cannot fix missing receipts they never receive.
whenToEngage: Need monthly SME bookkeeping after incorporation
Cloud ledger handoff to tax agent
Exit bookkeeping package before leaving Singapore
